personality_one_liner: Clean, modern Indonesian e-commerce focusing on physical retail experiences transitioning to a digital product-first interface, highlighted with vibrant orange accents.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a product-first approach; avoid dense packing.

do's: Apply to sticky headers over scrolling product feeds.
Apply to the bottom tab bar.
dont's: Never blur product form fields or body text regions.
Do not use on list rows or chips.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase featured banners, primary product categories, and trending products.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for banners and product carousels.
states.error: Failed to load feed with retry button.

screens.layout: Full-width hero banner carousel, followed by a horizontal category scroll, and a 2-column grid for product recommendations.

screens.name: Kategori
screens.purpose: Allow users to browse all products filtered by specific departments (Furniture, Dapur, Elektronik).

states.empty: Illustration of an empty aisle with a clear message.
states.error: Connection error state with a retry button.

screens.layout: Left sidebar or top horizontal scroll for parent categories, main area for a 2-column product grid with filter controls.

screens.name: Keranjang
screens.purpose: Manage selected items before proceeding to checkout.

states.empty: Empty shopping cart illustration with a 'Start Shopping' CTA.
states.error: Failed to sync cart data error message.

screens.layout: List of cart items with quantity steppers, followed by a fixed/sticky checkout CTA panel at the bottom including total price.

screens.name: Akun
screens.purpose: User profile management, order history, and settings.

states.empty: Guest mode prompt: 'Log in to view your orders'.

screens.layout: Simple list layout with grouped sections (Profile, Orders, Settings) and a sticky Logout button if authenticated.

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.purpose: Present comprehensive product information, images, and add to cart action.

states.loading: Skeleton for image and text blocks.

screens.layout: Large product image gallery at the top, followed by title, price, variants, and description. Highly crucial: Sticky 'Add to Cart' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Checkout
screens.layout: Single column form for shipping details and payment method selection. Sticky 'Pay Now' button at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality, prioritizing a highly legible and uncluttered product showcase.
Implement the vivid orange `#F15A24` as the primary brand color to match the requested ruparupa.com style.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' globally. Enforce a maximum font weight of 500 across all UI elements (never use 600, 700, Bold, etc.). Rely on size and color for typography hierarchy.
Limit the bottom tab navigation to exactly 4 tabs: Home, Kategori, Keranjang, Akun.
Ensure 'Add to Cart', 'Checkout', and 'Pay Now' are implemented as sticky CTAs anchored above the home indicator, overlaying scrolling content securely.
Apply 'expo-blur' (glassmorphism) behind sticky headers and the bottom tab bar to maintain depth when content scrolls underneath.
Always provide a gradient-to-dark scrim layer when rendering text directly over any background imagery (e.g., hero banners).
